answer: Resist Sybils with paid Sybil-hunting bounties: anyone who proves an identity is fake earns a copper bounty drawn from the fake's slashed bond, making clone-hunting profitable work. A fable of one operator hiding a hundred clones collapses once hunters are paid to look, because every fake becomes a prize to claim. Hunters stake a deposit against false accusations, and a rotating jury checks the evidence, so claims stay honest. Each exposed fake also reveals its funding delta: the whole cluster behind it loses standing together, so mass fakery puts a bounty on the farmer's own head.
